mapper.select: select temp.busiId busiId, fin.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, TEMP.booksetId booksetId, '02' recalType, '02' recalTypeVal, bok.BOOKSET_NAME booksetName, DATE_FORMAT(book.BOOKSET_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') cdate from ( select b.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, b.BUSI_ID as busiId from BOK_STAT_DET_POSIITON b where b.FINPROD_TYPE =#{finprodType} and b.BUSI_ID = #{finprodId} group by b.BOOKSET_ID, b.BUSI_ID ) temp left join BOK_BOOKSET bok on TEMP.booksetId = bok.BOOKSET_ID left join BOK_BOOKSET_DATE book on TEMP.booksetId = book.BOOKSET_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fin on temp.busiId = fin.FINPROD_ID and fin.FINPROD_TYPE =#{finprodType}
